newJutsu.battleDescription: %user does not rise. "Another echo come home."
newJutsu.description: The Command Crown answers its wearer. Its frost points glint, and every echo in the hall stands straighter.
newJutsu.name: The Crown's Will

newJutsu.battleDescription: %user lifts his chin. Red lines crack across the floor, fanning out from the throne.
newJutsu.description: Red lines fan out from the throne along the floor. Where they run, the crown's shards will fall.

effects.description: Primed: the set piece lands next turn

newJutsu.name: Crownfall

newJutsu.battleDescription: Shards of the crown fall point-first along the red lines.
newJutsu.description: Frost-pointed shards of the crown fall point-first along the marked lines.
newJutsu.name: Crownfall: the Fall

newJutsu.battleDescription: %user raises one hand. Violet chains coil across the floor; only three stars stay clear.
newJutsu.description: Violet chains coil across the whole hall. Three stars of skyglass stay clear.

effects.description: Primed: the set piece lands next turn

newJutsu.name: Command Absolute

newJutsu.description: The crown's sigil stamps down. Every chain locks around whoever stands outside the stars.
newJutsu.name: Command Absolute: Kneel

newJutsu.battleDescription: "Stand, soldier." An echo rises at his word.
newJutsu.description: The crown calls an officer of Crownhold back out of chakra haze. It stands for as long as he commands.
newJutsu.name: Recall

newJutsu.battleDescription: The crown's points crack loose and hang in the air. The floor glows red beneath them.
newJutsu.description: The crown begins to break apart above him. Its shards mark the floor where they will fall.

newJutsu.description: The crown's shards keep falling. Each volley lands where the last warning stood, and the next is already marked.
